summary: Read a real base and an integer exponent. The base is strictly above -100 and strictly below 100. The exponent is a 32-bit signed integer lying in the closed span from negative 2 to the power 31 through 2 to the power 31 minus 1. Compute the base raised to that exponent and write the real value. An exponent of 0 yields 1. A negative exponent yields the reciprocal of the power with the exponent made positive.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
